adaptiveFFT: Adaptive Fast-and-Frugal Trees

Source: R/adaptiveFFT-package.R
adaptiveFFT-package.Rd

Chain Fast-and-Frugal Trees (FFTs) of depth at most four — one cue per node, binary exits — fit by either FFTrees' greedy `ifan` algorithm or a beam search over the chain space. The [adaptive_fft()] constructor performs an inner-holdout race between the two families and refits the winner on the full training set.

Main entry points

* [adaptive_fft()] — constructor returning an `adaptive_fft` S3 object. * [run_beam_fft()] — standalone beam search. * [score_all()] — compute bacc / acc / f1 / auc / frugality. * [load_fft_dataset()] — load one of 14 FFTrees benchmark datasets.

S3 methods on `adaptive_fft`

* [print.adaptive_fft()] * [summary.adaptive_fft()] * [plot.adaptive_fft()]

Reproducing the benchmark

See `inst/bench/run_full_bench.R` and the `benchmark` vignette.
